text.id: Malem. Jam delapan lewat. Lampu jalan di gang ini cuma satu yang nyala, dan itu pun kedip-kedip.
text.en: Night. Past eight. Only one streetlight in the alley works, and even that one flickers.

text.id: Kalimat Tasya masih muter di kepala gue. "Ketemu narsum di dermaga."
text.en: Tasya's words are still going round in my head. "Meeting a source at the pier."

text.id: Mobil berhenti di depan pagar. Lampunya nggak dimatiin.
text.en: A car stops outside the gate. Its headlights stay on.

text.id: Din. Martabak. Telor spesial, buat Ibu juga.
text.en: Din. Martabak. The special egg one, some for your mom too.

text.id: Makasih, Kak Bima.
text.en: Thanks, Bima.

text.id: Dan lo pasti Raka. Sekar banyak cerita soal lo.
text.en: And you must be Raka. Sekar's told me a lot about you.

text.id: Cerita apa?
text.en: Told you what?

text.id: Yang bagus-bagus. Kebanyakan.
text.en: Good things. Mostly.

text.id: Kemeja linen, lengannya digulung. Jam tangannya nangkep cahaya lampu jalan tiap kali dia gerak. Dia nggak masuk pagar. Dia nunggu disuruh masuk, dan nggak ada yang nyuruh.
text.en: A linen shirt with the sleeves rolled. His watch catches the streetlight every time he moves. He doesn't come through the gate. He waits to be asked in, and nobody asks.

text.id: Tadi temen gue bilang grup pendengar heboh. Katanya akun Sekar bales.
text.en: A friend told me the listener group went crazy today. Said Sekar's account replied.

text.id: Temen siapa?
text.en: What friend?

text.id: Temen. Banyak yang dengerin podcast-nya, Ka.
text.en: A friend. Lots of people listen to her podcast, Ka.

text.id: Gue to the point aja. HP cadangan Sekar. Dinda bilang nggak ada, tapi...
text.en: I'll get to the point. Sekar's spare phone. Dinda says there isn't one, but...

text.id: Matanya turun ke saku celana gue. Cuma sedetik.
text.en: His eyes drop to my pocket. Just for a second.

text.id: Gue kenal orang di Polda. Lebih cepet daripada Polsek. Kasih ke gue, besok pagi udah ada di meja yang bener.
text.en: I know someone at the regional police. Faster than the local station. Give it to me, and by tomorrow morning it'll be on the right desk.

text.id: Dia ngulurin tangan lewat sela pagar. Telapaknya kebuka. Nunggu.
text.en: He reaches through the bars of the gate. His palm is open. Waiting.

text.id: "Pesan ini telah dihapus." Senin, jam delapan empat puluh.
text.en: "This message was deleted." Monday, eight forty.

text.id: Tangan Bima masih kebuka di sela pagar.
text.en: Bima's hand is still open between the bars.

text.id: "HP-nya kami pegang dulu."
text.en: "We're keeping the phone for now."

text.id: (Kasih HP-nya.)
text.en: (Hand over the phone.)

text.id: "Senin malem lo di mana, Bim?"
text.en: "Where were you Monday night, Bim?"

text.id: (Diam. Tangan tetap di saku.)
text.en: (Say nothing. Keep your hand in your pocket.)

text.id: Oke. Fair. Lo belum kenal gue.
text.en: Okay. Fair. You don't know me yet.

text.id: Tapi jangan lama-lama, Ka. Barang kayak gitu bahaya kalau dipegang orang yang nggak ngerti isinya.
text.en: But don't hold on to it too long, Ka. Something like that is dangerous in the hands of someone who doesn't understand what's on it.

text.id: ...Oke. Gue anggap itu "belum".
text.en: ...Okay. I'll take that as "not yet".

text.id: Gue ngeluarin HP-nya. Gue nggak tahu kenapa. Mungkin karena kedengerannya dia tahu mesti ngapain. Gue udah capek.
text.en: I take out the phone. I don't know why. Maybe because he talks like someone who knows how to handle things, and I'm tired.

text.id: Ujung jari Bima udah nyentuh casing-nya waktu tangan Dinda nyamber duluan.
text.en: Bima's fingertips are already on the case when Dinda's hand snatches it first.

text.id: Jangan.
text.en: Don't.

text.id: Ka. Lo baru kenal dia lima menit. Ini HP kakak gue.
text.en: Ka. You've known him five minutes. This is my sister's phone.

text.id: Din, aku cuma mau bantu.
text.en: Din, I just want to help.

text.id: Kalau mau bantu, bilang ke polisi Kak Bima ke mana Senin malem.
text.en: If you want to help, tell the police where you really were Monday night.

text.id: Di kantor. Lembur. Udah gue bilang ke polisi.
text.en: At the office. Working late. I already told the police.

text.id: Lembur. Terus jam sebelas malem lo nanya ke dia, "udah sampe?"
text.en: Working late. And then at eleven at night you ask her "did you get there?"

text.id: Lo baca chat gue? Itu privat, Ka. Lo nggak tahu apa-apa soal gue sama Sekar.
text.en: You read my messages? That's private, Ka. You don't know anything about me and Sekar.

text.id: Gue balik. Salam buat Ibu.
text.en: I'm going. Give your mom my best.

text.id: Dia jalan ke mobilnya. Lampu jalan kedip sekali, terus nyala lagi, pas mobilnya mundur.
text.en: He walks back to his car. The streetlight flickers once, then comes back on, just as the car reverses.

text.id: Di gelap tadi, gue kira mobilnya abu-abu. Kena lampu, warnanya perak.
text.en: In the dark, I'd thought the car was grey. Under the light, it's silver.

text.id: Mobil perak itu mundur pelan keluar gang, belok, terus hilang.
text.en: The silver car backs slowly out of the alley, turns, and is gone.

text.id: Kenapa lo ngelihatin mobilnya kayak gitu?
text.en: Why are you staring at his car like that?

text.id: Nggak tahu. Belum tahu.
text.en: I don't know. Not yet.

text.id: Hari kedua. Seseorang nelpon Tasya, dan dia diem. Seseorang jemput Sekar, dan dia bohong. Seseorang motret Sekar di dermaga, dan dia nggak ngomong apa-apa lagi.
text.en: Day two. Someone called Tasya, and she kept quiet. Someone picked Sekar up, and he lied. Someone photographed Sekar at the pier, and never said another word.

text.id: Semua orang di sekitar dia pegang satu potong. Nggak ada yang mau naruh potongannya di meja.
text.en: Everyone around her is holding one piece. No one wants to put their piece on the table.

text.id: Besok gue ke dermaga. Nyari kapal yang namanya ketutup ban.
text.en: Tomorrow I go to the pier. To find a boat whose name is hidden behind a tire.
